title: Rabbit and minstrel shows coming to New Orleans
summary: Talk about the drummer Rabbit who came with a minstrel show and Al G. Field's minstrels at the Tulane Theatre.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: Oh, I think his name was Thompson, I think. Bob Thompson, I think it was it. You know, Bill, we haven't talked about the minstrel shows at all.
Do they come in with him anywhere, do you think? You mentioned Rabbit. Somebody told me once he'd been small or rainy, but you... Rabbit, yeah.
Rabbit, he played minstrel shows. He came in here on the minstrel show, I think a jumper. But I didn't know Rabbit's name, though.
But he was a good drummer. I thought he was a good drummer. Did he play any other instruments? No, Rabbit, no.
Did they ever have many minstrel shows here, or was that mostly for the country out on the road, or what?
Well, the big minstrel shows, I mean, like L.J.'s Field, I seen them, I mean, years ago I seen them at the Tulane Theatre, I mean, I seen them, I seen them, my uncle take them, I see them.
